governance.elimfilters_base_decision_requires: A Donaldson or Fleetguard reference tied to a specific Isuzu OE/OEN by that manufacturer's own published evidence. An engine-level or vehicle-level match is not sufficient.
governance.fleetguard_may_only_become_base_when: Donaldson non-manufacture is itself VERIFIED (DONALDSON_NOT_MANUFACTURED_VERIFIED). DONALDSON_NOT_FOUND, DONALDSON_SOURCE_BLOCKED and DONALDSON_AMBIGUOUS never promote Fleetguard to base — this pass found zero cases of DONALDSON_NOT_MANUFACTURED_VERIFIED, so no row in this pass is Fleetguard-based.
governance.no_sku_without_db_check: This session had no live PostgreSQL/catalog access. The only checked-in, queryable catalog ground truth available was the repository's own competitor_cross_references_ld.csv / external_cross_reference_master_ld.csv exports. Every existing SKU reused in this pass was found there. Where a Donaldson part was confirmed but not present in those exports, no new SKU was invented — the row is left NO_ELIMFILTERS_SKU_YET pending a governance pass with live DB access.
governance.assembly_element_distinction_enforced: Every donaldson_part below is recorded with its Donaldson-published type (element vs cartridge vs spin-on vs kit) exactly as found; no assembly was declared equivalent to an element without saying so.
governance.no_automatic_production_publication: This file is a research + resolution manifest. Nothing in this pass wrote to catalog-write-gateway or any production table. Every elimfilters_base_decision is candidate/ready-for-review, not published.

source_channel_note: The prior attempt (2026-09-22, preserved below in access_blockers and engine_level_donaldson_evidence) found shop.donaldson.com blocked (HTTP 403 at the Akamai edge) and treated Donaldson as fully inaccessible. This pass found that donaldsontoolbox.com.au (Donaldson Australia's own cross-reference tool) is reachable, though its cross-reference data is loaded client-side by an Angular app and is not present in the raw HTML either — the same technical limitation as shop.donaldson.com, confirmed directly against both a plain fetch and a Googlebot-identified fetch. What unblocked real progress this pass was that Donaldson Toolbox generates SEO-friendly URLs and page titles of the form '{PART} - {DESCRIPTION} | Part Detail | Donaldson Toolbox' with the Isuzu OE numbers embedded directly in the URL slug (e.g. P552564-P552564-ISUZU-1132400740-HITACHI-4206080), and Google's search index has indexed a meaningful number of these. Those slugs and titles are Donaldson's own generated identifiers, so a URL/title hit is treated as DONALDSON_VERIFIED evidence, with the caveat that the full page body (which would show a complete cross-reference table) could not be independently re-rendered. Every such finding was additionally corroborated against at least one independent Donaldson distributor page (Western Filters, Total Parts, Filters Plus WA, GFC/Petroil, CYU Auto, Filters King, or similar) that reproduces the same Donaldson-to-Isuzu mapping in a traceable, detailed way, per this manifest's own rule that distributor literature is usable only when it reproduces official references traceably.
outcome_summary: 9 of 19 eligible Phase 2 OE/OEN rows now have a Donaldson-verified reference (3 of those as a full VERIFIED_BASE with an existing ELIMFILTERS SKU reused straight from the repository's own cross-reference export; 4 as PARTIAL, where the Donaldson reference is verified but does not confirm every Isuzu number carried in that Phase 2 row, or is linked to one of the row's numbers only transitively through a known Fleetguard-Donaldson equivalence; 3 more resolved on the Donaldson side but with no existing ELIMFILTERS SKU found in the checked-in catalog export, and no new SKU invented without live database access). The remaining 10 rows — plus H-Series, FRR, FXR and Cummins B6.7 as whole scopes — stay honestly blocked: DONALDSON_NOT_FOUND for the OE/OEN rows Donaldson has not catalogued (despite real search effort against Donaldson Toolbox and its distributor network), and BLOCKED_OEM for the vehicle scopes Phase 2 itself never produced an Isuzu OE/OEN for in the first place. No Fleetguard base was ever taken, because no row reached the DONALDSON_NOT_MANUFACTURED_VERIFIED bar the canonical rule requires before Fleetguard can become base.
